# OnlineDeveloperTool.com

> Free browser-based developer tools for formatting, validating, converting, encoding, hashing and generating data. No signup or account required. Covers JSON, JWT, UUID, Base64, URL and HTML encoding, hashes, cron, regex, XML, YAML, timestamps, colors and number bases.

Each tool has its own page with usage instructions and examples. Use the individual tool page as the authoritative source for what a tool supports. Do not assume features, APIs, pricing or integrations that are not described on the tool page.

## JSON Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-formatter/): Format JSON with readable indentation
- [JSON Validator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-validator/): Check JSON syntax and locate errors
- [JSON Beautifier](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-beautifier/): Beautify and pretty-print JSON
- [JSON Minifier](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-minifier/): Compress JSON by removing whitespace

## JSON to Code Converters

- [JSON to C# Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-csharp/): Generate C# classes with properties from JSON, including nested objects and arrays
- [JSON to TypeScript Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-typescript/): Generate TypeScript types from JSON
- [JSON to Java Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-java/): Generate Java classes from JSON
- [JSON to Python Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-python/): Generate Python code from JSON
- [JSON to Go Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-go/): Generate Go structs from JSON
- [JSON to PHP Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-php/): Generate PHP classes from JSON
- [JSON to Kotlin Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-kotlin/): Generate Kotlin classes from JSON

## Data Format Converters and Formatters

- [YAML to JSON Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/yaml-to-json/): Convert YAML into JSON
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/csv-to-json/): Convert CSV data into JSON
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/json-to-csv/): Convert JSON data into CSV
- [XML Formatter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/xml-formatter/): Format XML with readable indentation
- [XML Validator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/xml-validator/): Check whether XML is well-formed
- [YAML Formatter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/yaml-formatter/): Format YAML documents

## Encoders and Decoders

- [URL Encoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/url-encoder/): Percent-encode text for use in URLs
- [URL Decoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/url-decoder/): Decode percent-encoded URL text
- [Base64 Encoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/base64-encoder/): Encode text as Base64
- [Base64 Decoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/base64-decoder/): Decode Base64 into text
- [HTML Encoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/html-encoder/): Convert special characters to HTML entities
- [HTML Decoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/html-decoder/): Convert HTML entities back to characters

## JWT Tools

- [JWT Decoder](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/jwt-decoder/): Decode and inspect JWT header and payload
- [JWT Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/jwt-generator/): Generate JSON Web Tokens

## UUID Tools

- [UUID Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/uuid-generator/): Generate UUIDs
- [UUID Validator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/uuid-validator/): Check whether a UUID is valid
- [UUID Parser](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/uuid-parser/): Inspect the parts of a UUID

## Hash Generators

- [Hash Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/hash-generator/): Generate hashes from text
- [SHA-256 Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/sha256-generator/): Generate SHA-256 hashes
- [SHA-512 Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/sha512-generator/): Generate SHA-512 hashes
- [MD5 Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/md5-generator/): Generate MD5 hashes

## Date, Time and Scheduling

- [Timestamp Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/timestamp-converter/): Convert timestamps to readable dates and back
- [Unix Timestamp Tool](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/unix-timestamp/): Work with Unix timestamps
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/cron-expression-generator/): Build cron expressions
- [Cron Expression Parser](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/cron-expression-parser/): Explain and parse cron expressions

## Color Tools

- [Color Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/color-converter/): Convert colors between formats
- [HEX to RGB Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/hex-to-rgb/): Convert HEX colors to RGB
- [RGB to HEX Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/rgb-to-hex/): Convert RGB colors to HEX

## Number Base Converters

- [Number Base Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/number-base-converter/): Convert numbers between bases
- [Binary to Decimal Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/binary-to-decimal/): Convert binary to decimal
- [Decimal to Binary Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/decimal-to-binary/): Convert decimal to binary
- [Hex to Decimal Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/hex-to-decimal/): Convert hexadecimal to decimal
- [Decimal to Hex Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/decimal-to-hex/): Convert decimal to hexadecimal

## Text and Web Utilities

- [Query String Parser](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/query-string-parser/): Parse URL query strings into key-value pairs
- [Query String Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/query-string-generator/): Build URL query strings
- [Regex Tester](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions against text
- [Regex Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/regex-generator/): Generate regular expressions
- [Diff Checker](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/diff-checker/): Compare two texts and see the differences
- [Text Counter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/text-counter/): Count characters, words and lines
- [Case Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/case-converter/): Convert text between letter cases
- [Text to Slug Converter](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/text-to-slug/): Turn text into a URL slug
- [Slug Generator](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/slug-generator/): Generate URL-friendly slugs
- [Website Status Checker](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/website-status-checker/): Check whether a website is up

- [Fix JSON Parse Errors](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/fix-json-parse-errors/): Common JSON syntax errors and how to fix them
- [How to Decode a JWT](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/how-to-decode-a-jwt/): Reading JWT structure and claims
- [UUID v4 vs v7](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/uuid-v4-vs-v7/): Differences between UUID versions
- [Cron Expression Examples](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/cron-expression-examples/): Common cron schedules explained
- [RGB to HEX Conversion](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/rgb-to-hex-conversion/): How RGB and HEX color values relate
- [Decimal to Hex Conversion](https://onlinedevelopertool.com/guides/decimal-to-hex-conversion/): How decimal-to-hexadecimal conversion works
